Fig. 5. Comparison between edited results with and without inpainting process.

Fig. 1. Overview of the proposed Edit3DGS framework. The core components are multi-view batch editing and mask-based refinement, which together ensure both spatial consistency across views and preservation of facial expressions. At each timestep, selected camera views are rendered and edited using instruction-guided diffusion. The edited results across multiple timesteps are then aggregated to update the original Gaussian model through 3D fitting. After several iterations, the refined 3D avatar can be reprocessed through 2D editing to propagate changes to previously unseen timesteps.
